Introduction

ChaeYeon is a South Korean singer, dancer, rapper, actress, and model under MODHAUS.

In 2008, ChaeYeon made her debut as a child actress in the movie "Scandal Makers". From 2014 to 2017, she was a member of the kid group CutieL under IONE Entertainment.

She then debuted as a member of Busters under JTG Entertainment and Marbling E&M on November 27, 2017, with the single album "Dream On". Her departure from the group was announced by Marbling E&M on August 6, 2020.

ChaeYeon was introduced as the fourth member of the girl group tripleS under MODHAUS on June 22, 2022. She debuted with the first ten members of the group on February 13, 2023, with the mini album "ASSEMBLE".

As a member of tripleS, ChaeYeon was placed in the sub-units +(KR)ystal Eyes, ACID EYES, EVOLution, Aria, Hatchi!, and Sun.
